Yamato.why: Still the camp-clear and objective-path champion, but Flying Slash 26->23m and Shadow Transformation at T2/160s cap her engage reach; Celeste's nerfs open one lane while Mo & Krill's Scorn/Burrow buffs keep the sustain tank that outlasts her burst.
Yamato.notes:
11-04: no direct change; Celeste's silence/range/ult nerfs soften her worst lane, but Mo & Krill's Scorn/Burrow buffs keep the sustain tank that outlasts her burst.
Halloween 2026: Flying Slash 26->23m (T3 +15->+8m) with the mark visible on cast, Shadow Transformation 150->160s and moved to T2, Power Slash +6% spirit scaling. Hunter's Aura LOS gate and Healbane kill-heal 275->170 trim her late spirit line; Torment Pulse +4% melee resist helps her commit.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20): Flying Strike creates paths against solid targets (turrets, Shrines, objectives) for extra mobility/objective access; parry no longer resets on objectives, so her Shrine/Walker dive is one-shot.

Viscous.why: Splatter T1 and alt-fire growth give his lane poke real numbers, and Cube rescue gains from scheduled hub fights, but Mo & Krill's Scorn/Burrow/Combo buffs harden the frontline he already loses to and no post-patch win rate proves the 09-16 cooldown/Cube trims are absorbed.
Viscous.notes:
11-04: no direct change; Mo & Krill's Scorn 1.2x->1.3x, Burrow radius +0.5m and Combo HP 40->50 harden the frontline he already loses to.
Halloween 2026: Splatter T1 +36->+45 damage and +5% alt-fire damage growth per boon, Goo Ball melee/Ethereal Shift exploit during cast delay fixed; Express Shot secondary-fire -5% sits in his core. Tier holds B.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): Bell Tower's spread vaults and four corridors suit Goo Ball traversal, and harder camps plus forced hub fights raise Cube rescue value.

Pocket.why: The economy flipped in his favour: comeback gold and deficit-scaled secure fund the slow Affliction ramp. Celeste's silence/range/ult nerfs soften his worst lane, but he still folds to anything that out-ranges or sticks to a low-HP caster.
Pocket.notes:
11-04: no direct change; Celeste's silence T3 +1.25->+0.75s, Radiant Daggers 30->25m and Shining Wonder 160->170s soften his worst lane.
Halloween 2026 (indirect): the comeback levers (non-hero comeback cap 26->30%, tick souls to the two poorest, deficit-scaled secure speed) reverse the premise of his B-falling read — the farm bail-out now arrives before his Affliction spike. No core item moved.
Changelog: 09-16 - no direct line; 30-day usage shows no gun build (Monster Rounds 92%, Cultist Sacrifice 93%), so the spirit stack stands.

Mirage.why: Split-push hybrid the patch buried: souls moved off lanes into corridors and shared objectives, so sidelane pressure converts to less income, and Mo & Krill's Scorn/Burrow/Combo buffs strengthen the silence-lock tank he already loses to. Farm corridors instead; Djinn's Mark picks isolated camp clearers.
Mirage.notes:
11-04: no direct change; Mo & Krill's Scorn/Burrow/Combo buffs strengthen the silence-lock tank he already loses to; keep one Healbane, not two.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): souls moved off the lanes into corridors and shared objectives, so split-push converts to less income; Steam Vents give roamers a free approach on his map-play.
Paint the Town: no direct change; contested Soul Bags and earlier hub objectives worsen a slow split-pusher, and rising M&K/Lash dive him off his map-play — beaten by the meta, not the notes.

Vyper.why: Pure-gun carry whose spirit-amp splice is already gutted; Buff Containers' permanent Bullet Resist rolls tax her damage type and Barrel Mimics punish crate chains she cannot disengage from. Mo & Krill's Scorn/Burrow buffs make the lift/combo dive on her cleaner.
Vyper.notes:
11-04: no direct change; Mo & Krill's Scorn 1.2x->1.3x and Burrow radius +0.5m make the lift/combo dive on her cleaner.
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; Bullet Resist container rolls tax her gun all game and Barrel Mimics punish crate chains she cannot disengage from.
09-16: Slither T3 barrier 5->4s / Petrifying Bola cd 105->115s are cosmetic; the real hit is indirect (Mercurial Magnum gut + Plated Armor on-hit fix), tier A->B, build pivots to pure gun.

Mina.why: Mobile burst assassin with good farm shape, but her single-target rotation still cannot kill the tank front line, and both worst matchups got harder: Mo & Krill's Scorn/Burrow buffs and Ivy's rebound from the anti-heal cap. Yamato still owns the mobile-burst niche.
Mina.notes:
11-04: no direct change; Mo & Krill's Scorn/Burrow buffs and Ivy's rebound from the anti-heal cap harden her two worst matchups.
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; grouped Haunt camps and new districts suit her AoE clear and dive routes, but the tank frontline she cannot kill got better.
09-29 City Never Sleeps: no direct change; camp/uptime patch rewards grouped-camp AoE clear and new-district mobility, but her damage gap is unchanged.

Drifter.why: Blind-pickable spirit-melee bruiser whose roaming income got richer, but the anti-heal bruiser variant lost its edge with Healbane's 2-source cut 57.8->54.7%, and Apollo's Riposte disarm plus Mo & Krill's Scorn buff harden two losing lanes. Still no hard CC or closing mobility, so lane bullies cap him at B.
Drifter.notes:
11-04: Healbane 2-source cut 57.8->54.7% devalues the anti-heal bruiser variant; Apollo's Riposte disarm and Mo & Krill's Scorn 1.2x->1.3x harden two losing lanes.
Halloween 2026: base gun damage +3%, Bloodscent T3 +11%->+12% amp, Eternal Night T3 +2.5->2.75s; Haunt bounty/growth +10% raises his crate/vent roam income and multi-source anti-heal now composes with his built-in heal cut.
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; Steam Vents, new hiding spots and heavy-melee Tough Crates extend his stealth-roam and give his melee core uncontestable crate income.

Victor.why: Sustain frontline the patch fed: Spirit Lifesteal, Infuser and Torment Pulse compound his grind-down shell, and Healbane's stacked ceiling falling 82.2->72% makes the anti-heal that counters him weaker. Healing Booster's rework still delays his early curve.
Victor.notes:
11-04: no direct change; Healbane's 4-stack ceiling 82.2->72% weakens the stacked anti-heal that counters his sustain shell.
Halloween 2026: Aura of Suffering T3 +15%->+16%; Spirit Lifesteal, Infuser (6->8 spirit, 75% active lifesteal) and Torment Pulse +4% melee resist feed the grind-down core, while Healing Booster lost its Extra Regen link and +3 regen — buy it standalone, later.
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; harder Haunt camps, longer PvE routes and Buff Container Bullet/Spirit Resist rolls feed his sustain stack — A held.

Paige.why: Still the best lane-winning support, but base bullet 35->32 is roughly a 9% lane cut and the comeback economy rescues the carry she used to snowball past. Healbane's multi-source cut weakens the stacked anti-heal teams used to answer her heals, so the conversion is less punished than on 10-30.
countered_by: anti-heal (single-source Healbane, Toxic Bullets 40%, Crippling Headshot 40%)
Paige.notes:
11-04: no direct change; multi-source Healbane cut (2-stack 57.8->54.7%, 4-stack 82.2->72%) weakens the anti-heal answer to her heal shell.
10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: base bullet 35->32 (~9% lane cut; growth 0.52->0.61 pays back later); HVR velocity 60->45 weakens her 1.2-min buy — Opening Rounds before HVR is now the safer opener, and comeback gold blunts the lead she converts.
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; Healing Snacks let her lane pressure stick instead of resetting on a recall, and lane-adjacent crate routes from ~2:30 pay the lane winner immediately — S held.

Apollo.why: Riposte now disarms gun carries and holds 0.1s longer, so his parry punish converts picks instead of just interrupting; Itani Lo Sahn T3 +60% adds burst. Still an immobilize, not a stun, so channeled ults no longer break.
Apollo.notes:
11-04: Riposte Pommel Hit adds a disarm, T2 +0.6->+0.7s; Itani Lo Sahn T3 +50->+60%; Pummel ends the target's preexisting parry (wording unclear). Still an immobilize, not a stun.
10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: Riposte Pommel Hit is now an immobilize + parry disable, not a stun — 0.8->1.5s (T2 +0.4->+0.6s) with dash reliability fixes and CC refunds on Flawless Advance/Itani Lo Sahn. He loses the channel interrupt (Seven/Bebop/Harrow ults) and Healing Booster's gutting thins his sustain; S held, trend rising -> stable.
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; lane pressure converts into lane-adjacent crate routes and Healing Snacks, but the objective-parry change makes the Guardian dive a one-shot decision — S held.
